articles.title: The U.N. backs a new world map showing Africa in its true relative size - NPR
articles.description: The U.N. has backed a new map showing Africa in its true relative size, with the U.S. standing alone in opposition.
articles.content:
LAGOS, Nigeria The United Nations General Assembly has overwhelmingly backed a resolution aimed at changing the way Africa and other regions are represented on world maps.
